gazetteer.title: Forts traced from a map of North America (illustrative)
gazetteer.description: Illustrates how a geometry traced from a historical map, and placed in the world through a IIIF Georeference Annotation, records where it came from (PLATO issue #15; see plato:Geometry). The map and the annotation are real; the traced positions are illustrative.
